Class HistoricalScenarioCalibrationHarness

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.HistoricalScenarioCalibrationHarness
public class HistoricalScenarioCalibrationHarness extends Object
Historical Steady-Regime Calibration invalid input: '&' Multi-Resolution Sensitivity Harness.

Calibrates the core physical, demographic, and cliodynamic simulation engines against canonical historical epochs devoid of major systemic bifurcations/tipping points, enabling precise baseline parameter calibration before assessing non-linear disruptions.

Supports:

  • Intermediate Checkpoints Verification: Evaluates raster maps and socio-economic variables at multiple intermediate time horizons $t_k \in (t_0, t_1)$ to locate where and when deviations occur.
  • Empire invalid input: '&' Polity Spatial Localization: Verifies geographic centroids $(\text{Lat}, \text{Lng})$, territory coverage (Jaccard/Dice overlap), and demographic mass of historical empires.
  • Cartographic Tensor Comparison: SSIM, Pearson $r$, RMSE, and KL Divergence on Density, Sovereignty, and Technology layers.
  • Root Cause Drift Decomposition invalid input: '&' Automated Remediation: Differentiates historical stochastic shocks from unidirectional systematic engine biases, calculating exact correction multipliers.

Version:
1.0.0-academic
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
